<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD is a standard split package for a Wayland window manager (nimdow-wl) built from its upstream Git repository. It correctly pins the Nim dependency (parsetoml) as a verified tarball with a SHA256 checksum, while using `SKIP` for the VCS source — a normal and required practice for `-git` packages. The `build()` function compiles locally with `nim c` using only the already-fetched sources (`--nimcache` and `--path` point to `$srcdir`), so no network access occurs at build time. All `package_*()` functions perform routine `install` operations into `$pkgdir` with appropriate permissions, and the desktop subpackage declares a `backup` array for its config file. No obfuscation, unexpected downloads, `eval`, `curl|bash`, or manipulation of files outside the package scope is present. The code is consistent with ordinary AUR packaging and the upstream project's stated purpose.
</details>
